newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Sweden pledges $20 million in aid to Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Sweden pledges $20 million in aid to Cambodia.

text.p: Sweden on Thursday pledged $20 million in grants to Cambodia for social and economic development and human rights projects, officials said.

The money, for 1997 and 1998, will be channelled through multilateral organisations such as the United Nations, International Labour Organisation and through the Cambodian Mine Action Centre, the Cambodian government said in a statement.
Sweden had provided $62 million in aid to Cambodia since 1992, mostly for rural development, the statement said.
War-torn Cambodia derives about 40 percent of its national budget from foreign aid.
